title: Doc Comment Stub (symbol)
summary: Uses generate-docs to produce a doc-comment stub for one qualified symbol
intro: Read this when you want to start a DocInsight comment on one specific method, type or property. It produces a doc-comment stub for the chosen qualified symbol.

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Generate & Export > Doc Comment Stub (symbol)...
steps: Put the caret on the symbol in the editor
Choose drag-lint > Generate & Export > Doc Comment Stub (symbol)...
The doc-comment stub for the symbol is produced

questions.ask: How do I start a DocInsight comment on one method or type?
Can I get the stub in pasdoc style?
